column1: You have no reason to do that. Try to conduct yourself in a professional manner.
column2: 你沒有理由那麼做。請保持專業行為。

column1: That's a good way for you to wind up making license plates.
column2: 那樣做的結果，很可能是被送去製作車牌。

column1: Why in the world would you want to do that?? Your own car is outside.
column2: 你到底為什麼想那麼做？？你自己的車就在外面。

column1: You're very agreeable.
column2: 你真好說話。

column1: Probably not, huh.
column2: 大概不是吧，嗯。

column1: Just thinking about bains makes your blood boil.
column2: 光想到班恩斯就讓你怒火中燒。

column1: How may I help you? asks the agent.
column2: 「我能怎麼幫你？」租車員問道。

column1: We have wheels and we make deals, cracks the agent.
column2: 租車員開玩笑說：「我們有車輪，也會談生意。」

column1: We live up to our name! says the agent in all seriousness.
column2: 租車員非常認真地說：「我們表裡如一！」

column1: The agent tells you: "We handle everything from bicycles to Mack trucks."
column2: 租車員告訴你：「從腳踏車到麥克卡車，我們什麼都處理。」

column1: We have the lowest prices in town. Of course, wheels are extra! cracks the agent.
column2: 租車員開玩笑說：「我們有全城最低價。當然，車輪要另外收費！」

column1: The agent pipes up, "At Siva rent-a-car, we try softer!"
column2: 租車員插話：「在 Siva 租車，我們更溫柔！」

column1: The agent says, "I already showed you my list of rental customers, but if you insist....."
column2: 租車員說：「我已經給你看過租車客戶名單了，但既然你堅持……」

column1: Here you are, sir. Be my guest.
column2: 「給你，先生，請自便。」

column1: The Siva representative hands you his car rental agreements.
column2: Siva 代表把他的租車合約交給你。

column1: You carefully look over each car rental agreement, but you find nothing of interest.
column2: 你仔細查看每份租車合約，卻找不到任何感興趣的內容。

column1: Flashing a smile, the agent gives you her list of car rentals.
column2: 租車員露出笑容，把她的租車清單交給你。

column1: Who do you think you are? asks the agent. "We don't go around showing our rental agreements to people!"
column2: 租車員問：「你以為你是誰？」接著說：「我們不會隨便把租車合約給人看！」

column1: The agent looks at the mug shot and says..."Matter of fact, I do remember renting a car to this guy."
column2: 租車員看著嫌犯照片說……「事實上，我確實記得租車給過這個人。」

column1: You show the mug shot of Bains, and the agent says..."Nope, never seen the man before."
column2: 你出示班恩斯的嫌犯照片，租車員說……「沒有，之前從沒見過這個人。」

column1: The Siva rental agent says softly, "That's very nice, sir. Would you like to see a picture of my son?."
column2: Siva 租車員輕聲說：「真好看，先生。你想看看我兒子的照片嗎？」

column1: Anytime, Officer. Glad to help.
column2: 「隨時可以，警官。很樂意幫忙。」

column1: You're welcome, and remember: Siva tries softer!
column2: 「不客氣，記住：Siva 更溫柔！」

column1: Looking at the rental agreements, you come across a familiar name...."Luis Pate."
column2: 查看租車合約時，你看到一個熟悉的名字……「路易斯．佩特。」

column1: You think to yourself: "That punk has rented a car using the jailer's ID. I'd better jot down the information."
column2: 你心想：「那個混蛋用獄警身分證租了車。我最好把資訊記下來。」
